The Growing Need for a Second Bathroom in West Vancouver

West Vancouver homeowners face a common challenge: one bathroom works for two people, but not for a growing family, multi-generational household, or anyone juggling a busy morning routine. Adding a second bathroom is among the highest-ROI renovations in the area — and one that pays dividends both in daily comfort and at resale.

Reno Stars recently completed exactly this type of project in West Vancouver: converting one oversized single bathroom into two fully independent, code-compliant bathrooms. The result: two functional spaces where one existed before, with no loss of overall square footage.

West Vancouver Two-Bathroom Conversion: Project Overview

The project took one oversized primary bathroom and divided it into two separate bathrooms, each with its own plumbing rough-in, dedicated lighting circuit, and mechanical ventilation. This was not a cosmetic refresh — it required structural framing, new drain and supply lines, and full coordination with the District of West Vancouver building and plumbing departments.

Project at a glance:

  • Location: West Vancouver, BC
  • Scope: One oversized single bathroom → two independent bathrooms
  • Budget: $57,000 – $60,000
  • Timeline: 9–11 weeks from permit issuance to final walk-through
  • Permits: Building permit + plumbing permit (District of West Vancouver)
  • Outcome: Both bathrooms passed government inspection; all rough-in and finish work signed off

What the Conversion Involved

Converting one bathroom into two is more complex than a standard renovation. Here is what the process required on this West Vancouver project:

1. New partition wall: A new wood-frame wall was built to divide the original space. Because the existing bathroom was oversized, the resulting two bathrooms each remained generously sized — something that is not always possible in smaller West Vancouver homes.

2. Separate plumbing rough-in: Each new bathroom required its own drain line and hot/cold supply lines. Because both bathrooms share a wet-wall location, the cost was controlled — but running entirely separate lines to each space was still required by the BC Plumbing Code.

3. Dedicated electrical circuits: Each bathroom got its own lighting circuit, meeting current BC Electrical Code requirements for independent bathroom circuits.

4. Mechanical ventilation: Two bathrooms means two exhaust fans, each sized for the cubic footage of its respective space. In West Vancouver, where humidity from the rainforest climate can be significant year-round, proper ventilation is not optional — it is structural to keeping the finishes intact.

5. Permits and inspection: The District of West Vancouver required both a building permit and a plumbing permit. Both bathrooms passed final inspection, with sign-off from a registered plumbing inspector and building inspector.

Custom Finishes in Both Bathrooms

Both bathrooms were finished to the same high standard, using materials that hold up to West Vancouver's climate:

  • Floor-to-ceiling wall tiles — full water containment on all wet walls
  • Custom wood-grain vanity cabinets — built to fit the exact dimensions of each room
  • Modern ceiling trim and coordinated hardware throughout
  • All plumbing fixtures installed to manufacturer specifications and BC code

Both bathrooms received the same finish quality. No compromise between the two spaces.

What This Type of Renovation Costs in West Vancouver in 2026

The all-in budget for this conversion was $57,000 – $60,000. That covers demolition, new framing, new plumbing rough-in and finish plumbing, electrical, tiling, custom cabinetry, permits, and inspection fees.

That range is consistent with mid-to-premium bathroom renovation costs across the North Shore. What drives the cost up is the second set of plumbing rough-ins and additional electrical circuits — both of which are non-negotiable code requirements.

Key Considerations Before You Convert One Bathroom Into Two

If you are exploring this in your West Vancouver home, keep these factors in mind:

  • Permits are required. West Vancouver's building department will require a permit for any work that involves new plumbing fixtures or structural changes. Plan for 4–6 weeks of permit processing time.
  • Wet-wall location matters. The most cost-effective conversions position both new bathrooms against the same wet wall (existing drain and supply stack). If your existing bathroom is not already against a wet wall, costs increase significantly.
  • Existing bathroom size. You need enough space to create two functional bathrooms. As a rule of thumb, each bathroom should have at minimum: toilet, sink, and either a shower or tub. The original bathroom in this project was oversized, which made the conversion straightforward.
  • Hire a contractor with West Vancouver experience. The District has specific bylaw requirements and inspection protocols that differ from City of Vancouver. A contractor familiar with West Vancouver permits can prevent costly re-work.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does it cost to add a second bathroom in West Vancouver?
Based on 2026 project data, a full one-to-two bathroom conversion in West Vancouver typically ranges from $55,000 – $65,000 all-in, including permits and inspection. Cosmetic-only refreshes will be less; major layout changes with new plumbing runs will be more.

Do I need a permit to add a bathroom in West Vancouver?
Yes. Any work that adds new plumbing fixtures or alters the structural configuration of a bathroom requires a building permit and plumbing permit from the District of West Vancouver. A reputable contractor will handle the permit application as part of the project scope.

How long does the permit process take in West Vancouver?
Typical processing time is 4–6 weeks for a bathroom conversion permit in West Vancouver, depending on current queue volume at the District. Construction itself takes 8–12 weeks once permits are in hand.

Will adding a second bathroom increase my home value?
Yes. In West Vancouver's competitive real estate market, a second full bathroom is consistently cited by realtors as one of the highest-ROI improvements. Homes with two functional bathrooms command a measurable premium over comparable single-bathroom homes.

Can Reno Stars handle the permits and inspections?
Yes. Reno Stars manages all permit applications and coordinates required inspections as part of every renovation project. Both bathrooms in this project passed inspection on the first inspection visit.

溫哥華西家庭對第二間浴室的需求

住在西溫哥華的家庭常面臨一個問題：一家人早上搶用同一間浴室。第二間浴室不只提升日常生活的舒適度，更是房屋轉售時的高回報投資。

聚星裝修近期在西溫哥華完成了一個這樣的項目：將一間超大的單浴室改建為兩間完全獨立、符合建築法規的浴室。

西溫哥華兩間浴室改建案例

項目將一間超大的主浴室分隔成兩間各自獨立的浴室，每間均有獨立管道預鋪、專用照明電路和機械通風系統。這不是單純的表面翻新，而是涉及結構框架、全新排水和供水管線，以及與西溫哥華區建築和管道部門的全面協調。

項目概況：

  • 地點：西溫哥華，BC 省
  • 範圍：一間超大單浴室 → 兩間獨立浴室
  • 預算：57,000 – 60,000 加元
  • 工期：許可證核發後 9 至 11 週
  • 許可證：西溫哥華區建築許可證 + 管道許可證
  • 結果：兩間浴室均通過政府驗收

改建工程包含哪些項目

將一間浴室改建為兩間比一般翻新更複雜。以下是本項目的施工內容：

1. 新增分間牆：新建木框牆體將原有浴室一分為二。由於原浴室空間充足，兩個新浴室均有充裕的使用面積。

2. 獨立管道預鋪：每間新浴室均需要獨立排水管及冷熱供水管。BC 管道法規要求兩間浴室必須各有獨立管線。

3. 專用電路：每間浴室均設獨立照明電路，符合當前 BC 電氣法規對獨立浴室電路的要求。

4. 機械通風：

兩間浴室等於兩台抽風扇，每台均按各自空間的立方英尺計算風量。BC 省雨林氣候全年濕度高，通風系統不僅是美觀，更是保護室內裝修的結構性要素。

5. 許可證及驗收：西溫哥華區要求建築許可證和管道許可證。兩間浴室均通過最終驗收，獲得管道督察和建築督察的簽字確認。

兩間浴室的定製飾面

兩間浴室均採用同等高標準飾面材料：

  • 牆面瓷磚從地板鋪至天花板——全面防水
  • 定製木紋浴室櫃——按每間浴室的精確尺寸建造
  • 現代吊頂線條和協調的五金配件
  • 所有管道裝置均按製造商規格和 BC 法規安裝

2026 年西溫哥華浴室翻新多少錢

本項目全部費用為 57,000 – 60,000 加元，涵蓋拆除、新框架、管道預鋪及收尾、水電工程瓷磚、定製櫃體、許可證及驗收費用。

該價格與北岸中高端浴室翻新成本一致。主要成本驅動因素是第二組管道預鋪和額外電路——兩者均為法規強制要求，無法省略。

改建前的關鍵考量

  • 許可證必不可少。西溫哥華建築部門要求新增管道裝置或結構變更的工程必須申請許可證。建議預留 4 至 6 週許可證審批時間。
  • 濕牆位置很關鍵。最具成本效益的改建方案是將兩間新浴室對齊同一面濕牆（現有排水和供水管線）。若現有浴室並非靠濕牆，成本將大幅增加。
  • 現有浴室面積。改建需要足夠空間容納兩個功能性浴室。根據經驗，每間浴室至少需要：馬桶、洗手台，以及淋浴或浴缸。
  • 選擇有西溫哥華施工經驗的承包商。西溫哥華區的法規要求和驗收流程與溫哥華市不同。有當地施工經驗的承包商可避免代價高昂的返工。

常見問題

在西溫哥華增加第二間浴室多少錢？
根據 2026 年項目數據，西溫哥華兩間浴室改建全部費用通常在 55,000 至 65,000 加元之間，包含許可證和驗收費用。

在西溫哥華增設浴室需要許可證嗎？
需要。任何涉及新增管道裝置或改變浴室結構配置的工程，均需向西溫哥華區申請建築許可證和管道許可證。

西溫哥華許可證審批需要多長時間？
典型審批時間為 4 至 6 週，視區政府當前申請量而定。許可證核發後施工時間為 8 至 12 週。

增加第二間浴室會提升房產價值嗎？
會。在西溫哥華競爭激烈的房地產市場，兩間功能完整的浴室是地產經紀公认最高回報裝修之一。擁有兩間浴室的房屋較同類單浴室房屋有明顯溢價。

開始您的西溫哥華浴室翻新

無論您需要增設第二間浴室、更新老舊主浴室，還是重新規劃不實用的佈局，聚星裝修均以持牌承包商、500 萬商業一般責任保險及 WorkSafeBC 保障覆蓋每個西溫哥華項目。

每個裝修項目均以免費上門咨詢開始——測量、範圍討論，以及附有材料補貼的書面報價。無任何義務。
